Title: Consultant, Measles Surveillance Data and Information Systems
Company: Regional Health Organization (Fictitious)
Location: Remote
Deadline: 2026-11-02 23:59 EST
PURPOSE OF CONSULTANCY
The consultant will support countries of the region in strengthening the information
systems for the epidemiological surveillance of measles, rubella and other
vaccine-preventable diseases, in coordination with the national laboratory network.
DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES
- Analyse surveillance data on measles and rubella and prepare epidemiological bulletins.
- Support the laboratory network in integrating laboratory and surveillance data.
- Strengthen the SIVI surveillance information system in priority countries.
- Support outbreak investigation in coordination with ministries of health.
QUALIFICATIONS
- University degree in veterinary medicine, medicine, epidemiology or public health.
- Master's degree in public health or epidemiology.
- At least seven years of experience in epidemiological surveillance and health information systems.
- Proven experience with surveillance information systems for vaccine-preventable diseases.
- Spanish and English proficiency.
